extracted.intended_audience: advertisers and prospective authors targeting Annals of Internal Medicine (internal medicine physicians/subspecialists)
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the journal's mission, target readership, acceptable types of content, publication cadence, and key publication metrics to guide potential advertisers and authors about fit and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal mission / aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Annals of Internal Medicine is a peer-reviewed journal ... Its mission is to promote excellence in medicine, enable physicians and other health care professionals to be well-informed members of the medical community and society, advance standards in the conduct and reporting of medical research, and contribute to improving the health of people worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content submitted or advertised in the journal should align with these aims — supporting clinical excellence, informed practice, rigorous research reporting, and improvements in health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Audience: Internal medicine physicians and subspecialists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts and advertisements should be relevant to practicing internists and subspecialists; relevance to this professional reader base affects fit and likely impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of content accepted/published
rubrics_metrics.description: Annals publishes original research; scholarly, evidence-based reviews; clinical guidelines; commentaries; and editorials. In addition, the journal publishes papers related to medical education, health policy, ethics, and the history of medicine and essays that convey the art of medicine. I.M. Matters News is a new feature ... to provide internal medicine physicians and internal medicine subspecialists with timely news updates on clinical research, policy, medical education, and other topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should fall into the listed categories (original research, evidence-based reviews, guidelines, commentary/editorials, education, policy, ethics, history, clinical essays, or news-style updates) to be considered appropriate for the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-reviewed status and submission volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Annals of Internal Medicine is a peer-reviewed journal. Manuscript Submissions: Over 3,000 manuscript submission annually
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates a formal peer-review process and high submission volume — authors should expect competitive selection and rigorous review standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication frequency and schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Annals publishes new articles online every Tuesday, with print issues on the third Tuesday of each month.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and advertisers should account for the journal's weekly online publication cadence and monthly print schedule when planning submissions, press-timing, or advertising campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuing education (CME/MOC) inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: CME/MOC: Multiple options in every issue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal regularly offers continuing medical education and maintenance of certification content; authors may consider whether their work can be linked to CME/MOC activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circulation and audit information (reach/credibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: 2026 Projected Circulation: 97,015. Audited by: Alliance for Audited Media (AAM). For a current copy of our audit statement, please contact the Director of Advertising Sales.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These metrics inform advertisers about audience size and verified reach; advertisers should use audited circulation figures to assess value and placement decisions.
